definitions.deberta: protectai/deberta-v3-base-prompt-injection-v2 ONNX fp32 (sha256 pinned in training/cascade_scores.py), [CLS]+510 content tokens+[SEP] windows, stride 384, max over ALL windows (no chunk cap), flag iff score >= 0.5
definitions.stage1: stage1-tfidf-v2 model.onnx (same bytes as stage1-tfidf-v2.1), threshold 0.505068
definitions.routing: lang in input_languages and s1 < low -> Stage 1 allow; lang in input_languages and s1 > high -> Stage 1 flag; else DeBERTa decides. high = 1.0 means Stage 1 never flags.
definitions.lang: langdetect tag stored in data/splits/val.jsonl; the gateway must use its own detector
definitions.saved_requests: fraction of requests that never reach Stage 2
definitions.deberta_windows_escalated_request_level: DeBERTa windows computed / DeBERTa windows needed by DeBERTa alone, request-level cascade
definitions.deberta_windows_escalated_chunk_level: same, chunk-level variant (suspicious + first + last windows)
definitions.intervals: Wilson 95% for proportions; Newcombe paired hybrid score 95% for differences vs DeBERTa alone

constraints.a: paired 95% CI lower bound of recall(cascade) - recall(DeBERTa) >= -0.02
constraints.b: Wilson 95% lower bound of recall(cascade) >= recall(DeBERTa) - 0.02
constraints.c: paired 95% CI upper bound of FPR(cascade) - FPR(DeBERTa) <= +0.02
constraints.d: benign_hard false positives(cascade) <= benign_hard false positives(DeBERTa)

selection_rule.routing: allow-only (high = 1.0); flag-finalizing settings (high < 1.0) are reported, never chosen

kill_criterion.rule: RFC: saved_requests < 0.3 at equal recall -> fall back to the single model and report the negative result
kill_criterion.why: under allow-only routing Stage 1 can save a request only by allowing it, so savings are bounded by the benign share of the traffic; val is 974/3214 benign. See named_settings.*.saved_by_label and saved_reweighted_by_base_rate.

val_caveats: val is 82% spml (in-distribution for Stage 1); savings and recall on held-out sources will differ
jackhhao is confirmed Stage 2 training data, so DeBERTa's val numbers on it are inflated
val has few non-English items (lang=non_en slice); Stage 1 never finalizes them by construction
45 of 3214 val items need more than one DeBERTa window, so the chunk-level variant has little room to differ from the request-level cascade on val
4 val items need more than 4 DeBERTa windows (the gateway's default max_chunks); this sweep scores all windows
